name: architecture-pattern-selection
description: Select an architectural pattern (monolith / modular monolith / microservices / event-driven / serverless / CQRS / service-based / space-based) based on system context. Produces decision framework on team size, complexity, scale, latency, consistency, change frequency, observability needs. Per pattern: when-to-use / when-not / key trade-offs / reversal difficulty. Recommendation with trade-offs accepted and reversibility notes. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
